entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/checkout
entities.reasoning: NetworkChaos experiment targeted checkout pod causing IP set failures and request timeouts.
entities.evidence: k8s_events_raw.tsv contains NetworkChaos failure for otel-demo/checkout pod; alerts show CPUThrottlingHigh and RequestErrorRate spikes.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/ad
entities.reasoning: High request error rate and latency for ad service indicate it entered CrashLoopBackOff, reducing availability.
entities.evidence: alerts show RequestErrorRate and RequestLatency for ad; metrics/service_ad_raw.tsv shows increased latency buckets.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend observed 5xx errors due to downstream checkout and ad services failing.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alerts fire for namespace; trace data (otel_traces_raw.tsv) shows errors from downstream calls.

propagations.condition: checkout pods experienced network partition and high CPU throttling
propagations.effect: frontend received timeouts and returned HTTP 5xx

propagations.condition: ad service latency exceeded thresholds and entered CrashLoopBackOff
propagations.effect: frontend calls to ad failed, contributing to 5xx responses

alerts_explained.explanation: Error rate > threshold in otel-demo services, indicating downstream failures.
Observed latency > SLA for services, caused by ad and checkout slowness.
Checkout pods throttled CPU, worsening request latency.
No traffic observed for some services, likely due to upstream failures.
